policy_yaml:
# Example: hide supersecret/** from list/describe while allowing vend of one path.
# Server enforces this; kpm list --all only shows what metadata_list allows.
version: "1"
rules:
  - id: deny-list-supersecret
    effect: deny
    match:
      operations: [metadata_list]
      path_pattern: "supersecret/**"
    description: Hide supersecret tree from inventory (existence via list/describe)

  - id: allow-vend-supersecret-stripe
    effect: allow
    match:
      operations: [credential_vend]
      path_pattern: "supersecret/stripe-master"
    description: App may vend one path without seeing siblings

  - id: allow-list-and-vend-default
    effect: allow
    match:
      operations:
        - metadata_list
        - credential_vend
        - secret_write
        - secret_history
        - secret_delete
      identity:
        caller_id_pattern: "*"
    description: Default allow for other paths (tune for production)

  - id: allow-secret-purge-step-up
    effect: allow
    match:
      operations: [secret_purge]
      auth_strength: "cert+human"
    description: Purge always requires step-up (operation floor)
